- Supplementary AlphaFold models are fetched metadata-first from the AlphaFold DB API; mmCIF payloads are converted to PDB records by a deterministic converter inside the script, applied identically to every engine.
- No machine-specific path is recorded in any artifact.

## Interpretation constraints (unchanged from the frozen record)

- Diagnostic-only; no validation of v24 calibration, thresholds, cohorts, splits or the historical verdict-change table (OD-9, OD-14, OD-16).
- `contained_law_failures` is an old-engine artifact; the candidate intentionally has no containment policy, so its rows always show `[]`.
- `det_total` is derived per evaluation from rows whose `method` label is `deterministic`, identically in both engines.
- `LAW-110` sample semantics differ by design (old engine: positional set; candidate: `pairs_checked`, the pairs actually measured); this is verdict-neutral and documented in the candidate's registry row.
- `atom_coverage_return` is candidate-side only (the candidate's run_full_audit third slot); experimental structures stay at 100.0.
